limitations: Single-variant fetch: one geography, one device profile, no logged-in state, no cookie consent accepted. Personalization and geo/consent-gated content are not observed.
Lab proxy, not field data: latency and Core Web Vitals appear as risk factors measured once, not real-user metrics.
Network-dependent checks (sameAs resolvability, broken links) reflect what was reachable at audit time and are excluded from the byte-for-byte determinism guarantee.

findings.title: Type-warranting pages have no JSON-LD structured data
findings.evidence: 1/4 pages that read as product/article pages carry no matching schema.org JSON-LD (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43089/index.html). Sampled 1 type-warranting page(s).
findings.mechanism: Structured data lets machines read the exact fact (price, headline, author) instead of inferring it from prose; missing schema forfeits rich results.

suggested_action.summary: Add schema.org JSON-LD (Product or Article) matching each page's role so engines can extract the fact, not guess it.
suggested_action.mechanism: Structured data lets machines read the exact fact (price, headline, author) instead of inferring it from prose; missing schema forfeits rich results.

findings.title: No Organization entity anchor in JSON-LD
findings.evidence: No Organization/LocalBusiness/Corporation JSON-LD node on any sampled page (0/4 pages). Engines have no machine-readable brand node to anchor to.
findings.mechanism: AI engines resolve the brand string to a knowledge-graph node BEFORE evaluating page content; with no stable anchor, entity consolidation and knowledge-panel eligibility never begin.

suggested_action.summary: Add one Organization JSON-LD node with a stable @id, plus name, url and logo, on the homepage (and reference it site-wide).
suggested_action.mechanism: AI engines resolve the brand string to a knowledge-graph node BEFORE evaluating page content; with no stable anchor, entity consolidation and knowledge-panel eligibility never begin.

findings.title: Missing rel=canonical
findings.evidence: 4/4 pages have no rel=canonical link (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43089/about.html).
findings.mechanism: Without a canonical, engines may index a duplicate URL and attribute the fact to the wrong page, splitting authority.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential absolute rel=canonical to each key page.
suggested_action.mechanism: Without a canonical, engines may index a duplicate URL and attribute the fact to the wrong page, splitting authority.

findings.title: Media without reserved space and fonts without font-display cause layout shift
findings.evidence: 7 /
findings.mechanism: Media that loads without reserved dimensions and late-swapping fonts reflow the page (Cumulative Layout Shift), which frustrates readers and mis-taps.

suggested_action.summary: Set width/height (or CSS aspect-ratio) on media so space is reserved before load, and add font-display: swap to @font-face rules.
suggested_action.mechanism: Media that loads without reserved dimensions and late-swapping fonts reflow the page (Cumulative Layout Shift), which frustrates readers and mis-taps.

findings.title: Non-200 final status on sampled URLs
findings.evidence: 1/5 sampled URLs return a non-200 final status: http://127.0.0.1:43089/order-online.html -> HTTP 404 (not_found)
findings.mechanism: A crawler that hits a non-200 final response gets no content to index or cite from that URL.

suggested_action.summary: Investigate and restore 200 responses, or remove the dead links pointing here.
suggested_action.mechanism: A crawler that hits a non-200 final response gets no content to index or cite from that URL.

findings.title: Images ship at one size and load eagerly below the fold
findings.evidence: 4 below-fold content images missing loading=lazy across 3/4 pages. (Hero/first image intentionally excluded.)
findings.mechanism: Oversized single-resolution images waste bandwidth and delay paint; eager below-fold images compete with above-fold content for the network.

suggested_action.summary: Add srcset/<picture> responsive variants to large images and loading=lazy to below-fold content images; leave the hero/LCP image eager.
suggested_action.mechanism: Oversized single-resolution images waste bandwidth and delay paint; eager below-fold images compete with above-fold content for the network.

findings.title: No off-site identity surface found
findings.evidence: No sameAs, no footer/social profile links, and no Wikipedia/Wikidata link on any of the 4 sampled pages.
findings.mechanism: The large majority of AI brand mentions are sourced from third-party pages; with zero off-site surface there is structurally little for an engine to cite.

suggested_action.summary: Establish and link off-site identity surfaces (social profiles, Crunchbase, Wikidata/Wikipedia) and mirror them in Organization.sameAs.
suggested_action.mechanism: The large majority of AI brand mentions are sourced from third-party pages; with zero off-site surface there is structurally little for an engine to cite.

findings.title: Missing landmarks, skip link, or a clear above-fold value proposition
findings.evidence: no skip-to-content link on 4/4 pages. Heuristic; value-prop baked into a hero image is not detected.
findings.mechanism: Landmarks and skip links aid keyboard/screen-reader navigation; a clear above-fold value prop tells arrivals they're in the right place, reducing bounce.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap primary content in <main>, add a skip-to-content link, and lead with an H1 plus a one-line description of what the page offers.
suggested_action.mechanism: Landmarks and skip links aid keyboard/screen-reader navigation; a clear above-fold value prop tells arrivals they're in the right place, reducing bounce.
